title: 人工智能，从零搭建 · 第3部分：有意义的向量

chapters.JL: 15. 约翰逊–林登斯特劳斯引理，证明
chapters.Spectra: 10. 随机矩阵与训练过的权重

c4798ae0ecec.en: In part one, a model learned to guess the next letter by counting, and it hit a wall. Every context was its own island. <bookmark mark='a'/> Reading the dog barked a hundred times taught it nothing about the hound barked.
c4798ae0ecec.zh: 在第1部分，一个模型靠计数学会了猜下一个字母，然后撞上了一堵墙：每个上下文都是一座孤岛。<bookmark mark='a'/>把the dog barked读上100遍，也没让它学到关于the hound barked的任何东西。

054f0ae2861b.en: Every modern model fixes this the same way. It gives each word a place, <bookmark mark='a'/> a point in a space, chosen so that words used alike end up close together. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here are 102 words, where GPT-2 puts them: animals in one region, colors in another, then numbers, places, family, the body, and verbs.
054f0ae2861b.zh: 每一个现代模型，都用同一种办法解决这个问题：给每个词一个位置，<bookmark mark='a'/>也就是空间里的一个点，这些点的选法，让用法相近的词最后靠在一起。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是102个词，放在GPT-2给它们安排的位置上：动物在一个区域，颜色在另一个区域，然后是数字、地点、家庭、身体，还有动词。

30a10f3cad30.en: The picture is a shadow. <bookmark mark='a'/> GPT-2 really gives each of its 50,257 tokens a list of 768 numbers, and we've flattened them down to three, keeping the three directions along which these words spread out the most. <bookmark mark='b'/> Up close, dog sits with the other animals.
30a10f3cad30.zh: 这幅图只是一个影子。<bookmark mark='a'/>GPT-2实际上给它的50257个词元，每个都配了一串768个数，我们把它们压扁成3个，留下的是这些词散得最开的3个方向。<bookmark mark='b'/>凑近看，dog和其他动物待在一起。

5387d35491c6.en: Here is dog, all 768 numbers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is puppy. <bookmark mark='b'/> And here is tobacco. <bookmark mark='c'/> Two of these belong together, and in chapter one we'll learn to measure how much.
5387d35491c6.zh: 这是dog，全部768个数。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是puppy。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是tobacco。<bookmark mark='c'/>其中有两个是一路的，到第1章，我们会学会衡量它们有多接近。

3d1531a98da9.en: The mathematics is older than the machines. In 1844 Hermann Grassmann described quantities that add and stretch, in any number of dimensions. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1858 Arthur Cayley wrote down the algebra of matrices. <bookmark mark='b'/> Beltrami and Jordan found the singular value decomposition, <bookmark mark='c'/> and Hilbert named eigenvalues. <bookmark mark='d'/> Eckart and Young proved how to keep only what matters. <bookmark mark='e'/> Then meaning: John Firth's 'you shall know a word by the company it keeps'. <bookmark mark='f'/> Johnson and Lindenstrauss squeezed dimensions. <bookmark mark='g'/> Latent semantic analysis put words in a space, <bookmark mark='h'/> and Netflix offered a million dollars for filling in a mostly empty matrix. <bookmark mark='i'/> Then word2vec, <bookmark mark='j'/> and LoRA, GaLore and Muon, the same linear algebra inside today's training.
3d1531a98da9.zh: 这些数学比机器老得多。1844年，赫尔曼·格拉斯曼描述了可以相加、可以伸缩的量，而且是任意多维的。<bookmark mark='a'/>1858年，阿瑟·凯莱写下了矩阵的代数。<bookmark mark='b'/>贝尔特拉米和若尔当发现了奇异值分解，<bookmark mark='c'/>希尔伯特给特征值起了名字。<bookmark mark='d'/>埃卡特和杨证明了怎样只留下最要紧的部分。<bookmark mark='e'/>然后是意义：约翰·弗斯说，要了解一个词，就看它和什么词为伴。<bookmark mark='f'/>约翰逊和林登斯特劳斯把维数压了下去。<bookmark mark='g'/>潜在语义分析把词放进了一个空间，<bookmark mark='h'/>Netflix悬赏一百万美元，征求填补一个大半是空的矩阵的办法。<bookmark mark='i'/>接着是word2vec，<bookmark mark='j'/>还有LoRA、GaLore和Muon：同样的线性代数，进入了今天的训练。

6b04db7056e7.en: This is Part 3 of AI, Built. <bookmark mark='a'/> In it: vectors, the dot product and einsum; projections, eigenvectors and the singular value decomposition, each derived; norms, random matrices and what training writes into weights; word vectors; the geometry of high dimensions; and low rank at work. Every number computed, small enough for a laptop.
6b04db7056e7.zh: 这是《人工智能，从零搭建》的第3部分。<bookmark mark='a'/>这一部分讲：向量、点积和einsum；投影、特征向量和奇异值分解，每一个都会推导；范数、随机矩阵，以及训练往权重里写进了什么；词向量；高维空间的几何；还有实际中的低秩。每个数都是算出来的，小到一台笔记本电脑就能跑。

aaa8e097064c.en: Chapter one. Vectors, and how alike two of them are.
aaa8e097064c.zh: 第1章。向量，以及两个向量有多像。

904357f8b238.en: A vector is an arrow from the origin, <bookmark mark='a'/> or, just as well, a list of numbers: how far to go along each axis. <bookmark mark='b'/> Two numbers in the plane, three in space, and 768 for a word in GPT-2. <bookmark mark='c'/> Grassmann saw in 1844 that the algebra doesn't care how many numbers there are. Almost nobody read him for forty years.
904357f8b238.zh: 向量是从原点出发的一支箭头，<bookmark mark='a'/>也同样可以看成一串数：沿每条轴走多远。<bookmark mark='b'/>平面上是两个数，空间里是三个，GPT-2里一个词是768个。<bookmark mark='c'/>格拉斯曼在1844年就看出，代数根本不在乎有多少个数。可是四十年里几乎没人读他的书。

c1c17690ae94.en: Two moves make all of linear algebra. <bookmark mark='a'/> Add two vectors: walk along one, then the other. <bookmark mark='b'/> And scale them: stretch, shrink or flip. Mix the two, a times u plus b times v, <bookmark mark='c'/> and the tip sweeps out the whole plane: u and v are a basis, and every vector has exactly one pair of coordinates in it.
c1c17690ae94.zh: 整个线性代数，只用两个动作。<bookmark mark='a'/>把两个向量相加：先沿一个走，再沿另一个走。<bookmark mark='b'/>再就是缩放：拉长、缩短，或者翻转。把两个动作混起来，a乘u加b乘v，<bookmark mark='c'/>箭头尖扫过整个平面：u和v就是一组基，每个向量在这组基下，都有唯一的一对坐标。

bb8cc9e2ab49.en: How alike are two vectors? <bookmark mark='a'/> Multiply them coordinate by coordinate and add: the dot product, or inner product. It is symmetric, linear in each slot, and a vector dotted with itself is its length squared. <bookmark mark='b'/> Draw the triangle with sides a, b and a minus b. Its third side squared is a dot product. <bookmark mark='c'/> Expand it. <bookmark mark='d'/> Euclid's law of cosines gives the same side another way. <bookmark mark='e'/> Compare: the dot product is the two lengths times the cosine of the angle between them.
bb8cc9e2ab49.zh: 两个向量有多像？<bookmark mark='a'/>把它们逐个坐标相乘，再加起来：这就是点积，也叫内积。它是对称的，对每个位置都是线性的，一个向量和自己的点积，就是它长度的平方。<bookmark mark='b'/>画一个三角形，三条边是a、b和a减b。第三条边的平方，是一个点积。<bookmark mark='c'/>把它展开。<bookmark mark='d'/>欧几里得的余弦定理，从另一条路算出同一条边。<bookmark mark='e'/>两相比较：点积等于两个长度，乘以它们夹角的余弦。

e1d25c8abe56.en: Divide by the two lengths and you get the cosine similarity, which runs from minus one to one. <bookmark mark='a'/> For GPT-2's words: dog and puppy, 0.62. Dog and cat, 0.55. Dog and tobacco, 0.23. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 768 dimensions you can't draw the angle, but you can compute it: multiply the two lists number by number, and add.
e1d25c8abe56.zh: 除以两个长度，就得到余弦相似度，它在负1到1之间。<bookmark mark='a'/>拿GPT-2的词来说：dog和puppy，0.62。dog和cat，0.55。dog和tobacco，0.23。<bookmark mark='b'/>在768维里画不出夹角，但可以算出来：把两串数逐个相乘，再加起来。

14214e1ed066.en: Here is why this matters. In Part 1, a network ended with a score for every possible next token, and the softmax turned scores into probabilities. <bookmark mark='a'/> In GPT-2, each score is a dot product: the model's final state with each token's vector, the very vectors the tokens started out as. <bookmark mark='b'/> After the Eiffel Tower is located in the city of, the biggest dot products belong to Paris, London, Amsterdam. <bookmark mark='c'/> The softmax gives Paris 6.4 percent.
14214e1ed066.zh: 这为什么重要？在第1部分，网络最后给每个可能的下一个词元打一个分，softmax再把分数变成概率。<bookmark mark='a'/>在GPT-2里，每个分数都是一个点积：模型最后的状态，和每个词元的向量相点乘，用的正是词元一开始的那些向量。<bookmark mark='b'/>在“埃菲尔铁塔位于哪座城市”这句话之后，点积最大的是Paris、London、Amsterdam。<bookmark mark='c'/>softmax给Paris的概率是6.4%。

60c3b29e53ea.en: Chapter two. Tensors, and the notation attention is written in.
60c3b29e53ea.zh: 第2章。张量，以及注意力所用的记法。

05d28bfce610.en: A number, a vector, a matrix: zero, one and two axes. <bookmark mark='a'/> A batch of text is a list of sentences, each a list of tokens, each a list of numbers: three axes, what machine learning calls a tensor. <bookmark mark='b'/> Attention splits the numbers among 12 heads: four. Products of such arrays need a notation that names the axes.
05d28bfce610.zh: 一个数、一个向量、一个矩阵：零根、一根、两根轴。<bookmark mark='a'/>一批文本是一串句子，每句是一串词元，每个词元是一串数：三根轴，机器学习管它叫张量。<bookmark mark='b'/>注意力把这些数分给12个头：四根轴。这样的数组相乘，需要一种能给轴起名字的记法。

e6ed06c28e5e.en: Multiplying two matrices: entry i k is row i of A against column k of B, summed over j. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1916, writing general relativity, Einstein tired of summation signs and dropped them: an index that appears twice is summed. <bookmark mark='b'/> Programs adopted the idea as einsum, with a letter for each axis. <bookmark mark='c'/> A letter in the output is kept; a letter only in the inputs is summed away. And the cost is one multiply-add for every combination of the letters: i times j times k.
e6ed06c28e5e.zh: 两个矩阵相乘：结果的第i行第k列，是A的第i行和B的第k列逐项相乘，再对j求和。<bookmark mark='a'/>1916年，爱因斯坦在写广义相对论时，写烦了求和号，干脆把它省掉：一个指标出现两次，就表示对它求和。<bookmark mark='b'/>程序把这个想法做成了einsum，每根轴用一个字母表示。<bookmark mark='c'/>出现在输出里的字母保留；只出现在输入里的字母被求和消掉。计算量也一目了然：所有字母的每一种组合，做一次乘加，这里是i乘j乘k。

9b47c8b4a7b9.en: One function does all of these. <bookmark mark='a'/> The dot product: multiply, and sum everything. <bookmark mark='b'/> The outer product: nothing summed, a matrix of rank one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Matrix times vector. <bookmark mark='d'/> The transpose, which only reorders. <bookmark mark='e'/> The trace. <bookmark mark='f'/> And a batch of matrix products, the letter b carried along.
9b47c8b4a7b9.zh: 一个函数，就能做这些事。<bookmark mark='a'/>点积：相乘，全部加起来。<bookmark mark='b'/>外积：什么都不求和，得到一个秩为1的矩阵。<bookmark mark='c'/>矩阵乘向量。<bookmark mark='d'/>转置，只是换个顺序。<bookmark mark='e'/>迹。<bookmark mark='f'/>还有一整批矩阵乘法，字母b一路带着走。

e8b380109831.en: Here is attention, Part 13's subject, in this notation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each token's vector is projected into queries, keys and values, split among heads. <bookmark mark='b'/> Every query is dotted with every key: e is summed away. <bookmark mark='c'/> A softmax turns scores into weights, which average the values. <bookmark mark='d'/> The heads are merged back. <bookmark mark='e'/> Read the costs off the letters. For 1,024 tokens, the scores take about 805 million multiply-adds per layer, and the projections 2,416 million. The scores grow with the square of the length: that is why long contexts are expensive.
e8b380109831.zh: 用这种记法写注意力，也就是第13部分的主题。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个词元的向量，投影成查询、键和值，再分给各个头。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个查询和每个键做点积：e被求和消掉。<bookmark mark='c'/>softmax把分数变成权重，权重再对值求平均。<bookmark mark='d'/>最后把各个头合并回去。<bookmark mark='e'/>从字母里直接读出计算量。对1024个词元，打分每层大约要805百万次乘加，投影要2416百万次。打分随长度的平方增长：这就是长上下文昂贵的原因。

8e9831c84431.en: The letters also show that order matters. <bookmark mark='a'/> A is 1,000 by 20, B is 20 by 1,000, C is 1,000 by 20. <bookmark mark='b'/> Multiply A and B first, and you build a 1,000 by 1,000 matrix on the way: 40,000,000 multiply-adds. <bookmark mark='c'/> B and C first: 800,000. The same answer, 50 times cheaper. <bookmark mark='d'/> einsum can find the cheap order itself; here it multiplies B and C first.
8e9831c84431.zh: 这些字母还说明，顺序很重要。<bookmark mark='a'/>A是1000乘20，B是20乘1000，C是1000乘20。<bookmark mark='b'/>先乘A和B，途中就造出一个1000乘1000的矩阵：40000000次乘加。<bookmark mark='c'/>先乘B和C：800000次。结果一样，便宜了50倍。<bookmark mark='d'/>einsum可以自己找出便宜的顺序；这里，它先乘B和C。

ce68dba99062.zh: 第3章。矩阵让空间动起来。

f820be8e45a9.en: A matrix moves every vector at once. <bookmark mark='a'/> It keeps the origin where it is, and keeps grid lines straight, parallel, and evenly spaced: it's a linear map. <bookmark mark='b'/> Watch the whole plane move.
f820be8e45a9.zh: 一个矩阵，同时移动所有的向量。<bookmark mark='a'/>它让原点留在原处，让网格线保持笔直、平行、间距均匀：这就是线性映射。<bookmark mark='b'/>看整个平面怎样移动。

2c0a5eaeeeff.en: Where does each vector go? <bookmark mark='a'/> Only two arrows decide it: where the two basis arrows land. Those landing spots are the columns of the matrix. <bookmark mark='b'/> A vector with coordinates one and two lands at one times the first column, plus two times the second. That's what multiplying a matrix by a vector means.
2c0a5eaeeeff.zh: 每个向量去了哪里？<bookmark mark='a'/>只要看两支箭头就够了：两支基向量落在哪里。这两个落点，就是矩阵的两列。<bookmark mark='b'/>坐标为1和2的向量，落在1乘第一列，加2乘第二列。这就是矩阵乘向量的意思。

d64f3a59c0c0.en: One map after another is again a map, and its matrix is the product of the two. <bookmark mark='a'/> But the order matters: turning, then shearing, is not shearing, then turning. <bookmark mark='b'/> Arthur Cayley made matrices objects in their own right in 1858, with exactly this rule; his friend James Joseph Sylvester had named them eight years before.
d64f3a59c0c0.zh: 一个映射接着另一个映射，仍然是一个映射，它的矩阵就是两个矩阵的乘积。<bookmark mark='a'/>但顺序很重要：先转再剪切，不同于先剪切再转。<bookmark mark='b'/>1858年，阿瑟·凯莱把矩阵本身当成研究对象，规则正是这样；他的朋友詹姆斯·约瑟夫·西尔维斯特，八年前就给它们起了名字。

d4c62614bc14.en: One number says how much a map stretches area: the determinant. <bookmark mark='a'/> The unit square becomes a parallelogram, and the determinant is its area. <bookmark mark='b'/> When the determinant reaches zero, the whole plane is squashed onto a line, and information is lost for good. <bookmark mark='c'/> Below zero, the plane has been flipped over, like a page turned face down.
d4c62614bc14.zh: 有一个数，说明映射把面积拉大了多少：行列式。<bookmark mark='a'/>单位正方形变成一个平行四边形，行列式就是它的面积。<bookmark mark='b'/>行列式到了0，整个平面被压成一条线，信息就永远丢了。<bookmark mark='c'/>小于0，平面被翻了过来，就像把一页纸扣过去。

1d0f27988dff.en: That squashing has a name, and it will matter for the rest of this part. <bookmark mark='a'/> This matrix sends the whole plane onto one line: its columns point the same way. <bookmark mark='b'/> The line where everything lands is the column space, and its dimension is the rank, here one. <bookmark mark='c'/> A whole line of vectors lands on zero: the null space. <bookmark mark='d'/> The dimensions always add up: rank plus the null space's dimension is the number of columns. A matrix of low rank is a big table that carries few independent directions.
1d0f27988dff.zh: 这种压扁有个名字，而且这一部分后面都用得着。<bookmark mark='a'/>这个矩阵把整个平面送到一条线上：它的两列指向同一个方向。<bookmark mark='b'/>所有东西落到的那条线，叫列空间，它的维数就是秩，这里是1。<bookmark mark='c'/>有一整条线上的向量，都落到了0：这叫零空间。<bookmark mark='d'/>维数总是加得起来：秩加上零空间的维数，等于列数。一个低秩的矩阵，就是一张大表，却只含有很少几个独立的方向。

20d4303cf4c2.en: Chapter four. Projections, and the closest point.
20d4303cf4c2.zh: 第4章。投影，以及最近的点。

1e9241ff7f85.en: The dot product measured a shadow; here is the shadow made exact. <bookmark mark='a'/> Which point on the line through a is closest to b? <bookmark mark='b'/> Some multiple of a, <bookmark mark='c'/> the one whose error, b minus that point, is perpendicular to the line: any other point is farther, by Pythagoras. <bookmark mark='d'/> Solve for the multiple. <bookmark mark='e'/> The projection is a matrix times b: a times a transpose, over a dot a. A matrix of rank one, that finds shadows.
1e9241ff7f85.zh: 点积量的是影子；这里，把影子算准。<bookmark mark='a'/>过a的直线上，哪一点离b最近？<bookmark mark='b'/>它是a的某个倍数，<bookmark mark='c'/>是让误差，也就是b减去这一点，垂直于直线的那一个：根据勾股定理，其他点都更远。<bookmark mark='d'/>解出这个倍数。<bookmark mark='e'/>投影就是一个矩阵乘b：a乘a转置，除以a点a。一个秩为1、专找影子的矩阵。

bf1cecd97325.en: Now project onto a subspace: everything you can reach by combining the columns of a matrix A. <bookmark mark='a'/> The closest point is A times some x hat, and the error is perpendicular to every column at once. <bookmark mark='b'/> Multiply out: the normal equations. <bookmark mark='c'/> If the columns are independent, A transpose A can be inverted. <bookmark mark='d'/> The projection matrix: A, A transpose A inverse, A transpose. <bookmark mark='e'/> Project twice and nothing more happens; and P is symmetric. <bookmark mark='f'/> Legendre published this in 1805 as least squares, and Gauss in 1809, who had used it to find the lost asteroid Ceres.
bf1cecd97325.zh: 现在投影到一个子空间上：也就是矩阵A的列能组合出来的一切。<bookmark mark='a'/>最近的点是A乘某个x帽，误差同时垂直于每一列。<bookmark mark='b'/>乘开来：正规方程。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果各列线性无关，A转置A就可逆。<bookmark mark='d'/>投影矩阵：A，乘A转置A的逆，再乘A转置。<bookmark mark='e'/>投影两次，不会再有变化；而且P是对称的。<bookmark mark='f'/>勒让德在1805年以最小二乘法的名字发表了它，高斯在1809年也发表了，他早就用它找到了失踪的小行星谷神星。

4c0e7a099525.en: This is the most used calculation in statistics. <bookmark mark='a'/> Fourteen points and a line. The columns of A are ones and the x values; the best line is the projection of the y values onto their span. <bookmark mark='b'/> The errors are perpendicular to both columns: they sum to zero, and so do the errors times x. <bookmark mark='c'/> Regression, a linear probe reading a concept out of a network, a last layer trained with squared error: all this projection.
4c0e7a099525.zh: 这是统计学里用得最多的计算。<bookmark mark='a'/>十四个点，一条直线。A的两列是一列1和x的值；最好的直线，就是把y的值投影到这两列张成的平面上。<bookmark mark='b'/>误差垂直于两列：误差加起来是0，误差乘x加起来也是0。<bookmark mark='c'/>回归、从网络里读出一个概念的线性探针、用平方误差训练的最后一层：全都是这个投影。

f2c2fc8b3ef1.en: Projections are easiest with an orthonormal basis, perpendicular arrows of length one: then the projection is Q times Q transpose. <bookmark mark='a'/> Gram and Schmidt's recipe makes one from any basis. Scale the first vector to length one. <bookmark mark='b'/> From the second, remove its shadow on the first; what is left is perpendicular. <bookmark mark='c'/> Scale it, and repeat. <bookmark mark='d'/> Keeping the coefficients writes A as Q times a triangular R: the QR factorization.
f2c2fc8b3ef1.zh: 用标准正交基做投影最省事，也就是一组互相垂直、长度为1的箭头：这时投影就是Q乘Q转置。<bookmark mark='a'/>格拉姆和施密特的方法，能从任何一组基造出这样的基。先把第一个向量缩放到长度1。<bookmark mark='b'/>从第二个向量里，减去它在第一个上的影子；剩下的就垂直了。<bookmark mark='c'/>再缩放，如此重复。<bookmark mark='d'/>把系数留下来，就把A写成了Q乘一个三角矩阵R：这就是QR分解。

e60ec357e3c6.en: On a computer every step rounds, and rounding can pile up. We tested on Hilbert matrices, whose columns become nearly dependent. <bookmark mark='a'/> The classical recipe loses orthogonality as the square of the condition number: at a condition number of ten to the 6, its Q is off by about ten to the minus 6. By the end, its vectors are not perpendicular at all. <bookmark mark='b'/> The modified recipe, which takes each shadow from the updated vector, loses only in proportion. <bookmark mark='c'/> Alston Householder's reflections, from 1958, stay perpendicular to about ten to the minus 15, the machine's precision. <bookmark mark='d'/> The normal equations share the classical flaw: forming A transpose A squares the condition number. At the hardest case QR's answer is off by ten to the minus 1, against an error bigger than the answer itself for the normal equations. That is why libraries solve least squares with QR.
e60ec357e3c6.zh: 在计算机上，每一步都要舍入，舍入误差会越积越多。我们在希尔伯特矩阵上做了测试，它的各列几乎线性相关。<bookmark mark='a'/>经典的方法失去正交性的程度，和条件数的平方成正比：条件数为10的6次方时，它的Q偏差大约是10的负6次方。到最后，它的向量已经完全不垂直了。<bookmark mark='b'/>改进的方法，每次从更新过的向量上取影子，损失只和条件数成正比。<bookmark mark='c'/>阿尔斯通·豪斯霍尔德1958年的反射法，一直保持垂直，偏差大约是10的负15次方，也就是机器精度。<bookmark mark='d'/>正规方程也有经典方法的毛病：一构造A转置A，条件数就平方了。在最难的情形，QR的答案偏差是10的负1次方，而正规方程的误差，比答案本身还大。所以各种程序库都用QR来解最小二乘。

3b8cc16ceeed.en: Chapter five. Eigenvectors, and the spectral theorem.
3b8cc16ceeed.zh: 第5章。特征向量，以及谱定理。

4ddb7e4937ba.en: Most vectors are knocked off their line by a matrix. <bookmark mark='a'/> Some aren't: they stay on their line, only stretched or shrunk. <bookmark mark='b'/> Those are the eigenvectors, and the stretch is the eigenvalue. A minus lambda I must then squash a direction to zero, so its determinant vanishes: a polynomial equation for lambda.
4ddb7e4937ba.zh: 大多数向量，都会被矩阵撞离自己所在的直线。<bookmark mark='a'/>有些不会：它们留在自己的直线上，只被拉长或缩短。<bookmark mark='b'/>它们就是特征向量，拉伸的倍数就是特征值。这时A减λI必须把一个方向压成0，所以它的行列式为0：这是一个关于λ的多项式方程。

1f768d427a62.en: Symmetric matrices, equal to their mirror image across the diagonal, behave best. <bookmark mark='a'/> Their eigenvalues are real, and their eigenvectors perpendicular. <bookmark mark='b'/> So the map is: turn the eigenvectors onto the axes, stretch each axis by its eigenvalue, and turn back. <bookmark mark='c'/> A equals Q, Lambda, Q transpose; for a turn like Q, the transpose is the same turn, undone. That's the spectral theorem.
1f768d427a62.zh: 对称矩阵，也就是沿对角线翻过来不变的矩阵，性质最好。<bookmark mark='a'/>它们的特征值是实数，特征向量互相垂直。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以这个映射就是：把特征向量转到坐标轴上，沿每根轴按特征值拉伸，再转回去。<bookmark mark='c'/>A等于Q乘Λ乘Q转置；对Q这样的旋转，转置就是同一个旋转，倒过来。这就是谱定理。

a38b03836899.en: Why does it always work? The proof has three steps. <bookmark mark='a'/> First, the eigenvalues are real: sandwich A between an eigenvector and its complex conjugate. Since A is real and symmetric, the middle number equals its own conjugate, so lambda equals lambda bar. <bookmark mark='b'/> Second, eigenvectors with different eigenvalues are perpendicular: move A across the dot product, and the eigenvalues must agree unless the dot product is zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> Third, A maps the space perpendicular to an eigenvector into itself, so repeat inside it: by induction, a full set. Cauchy proved the first part in 1829; Hilbert took it to infinite dimensions.
a38b03836899.zh: 为什么总是成立？证明分三步。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一，特征值是实数：把A夹在一个特征向量和它的复共轭之间。因为A是实的、对称的，中间这个数等于它自己的共轭，所以λ等于λ的共轭。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二，特征值不同的特征向量互相垂直：把A从点积的一边挪到另一边，两个特征值必须相等，除非点积为0。<bookmark mark='c'/>第三，A把垂直于一个特征向量的空间映到它自己，于是在里面重复同样的步骤：用归纳法，得到一整组。柯西在1829年证明了第一部分；希尔伯特把它推广到了无穷维。

557b61bde977.en: One number connects eigenvalues to what follows: the Rayleigh quotient, x transpose A x over x transpose x. <bookmark mark='a'/> In the eigenvector basis it is a weighted average of the eigenvalues. <bookmark mark='b'/> So as x turns, it stays between the smallest and the largest eigenvalue, reaching them along the eigenvectors. <bookmark mark='c'/> The top eigenvector answers a question: which direction does A favour most? It returns as principal components, power iteration and the SVD.
557b61bde977.zh: 有一个数，把特征值和后面的内容连起来：瑞利商，x转置A x，除以x转置x。<bookmark mark='a'/>在特征向量基下，它是各个特征值的加权平均。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以当x转动时，它总在最小和最大的特征值之间，只有沿着特征向量才取到它们。<bookmark mark='c'/>最大特征值的特征向量回答了一个问题：A最偏爱哪个方向？它还会以主成分、幂迭代和奇异值分解的样子回来。

4f2b0d713390.en: Covariance matrices describe how data spreads: <bookmark mark='c'/> how much each coordinate varies, on the diagonal, and how much pairs vary together, off it. The spread along a unit direction is the covariance's Rayleigh quotient, so the direction of greatest spread is the top eigenvector. <bookmark mark='a'/> These are the principal components, Pearson's in 1901 and Hotelling's in 1933. <bookmark mark='b'/> Keeping the top few is how we drew GPT-2's words in three dimensions.
4f2b0d713390.zh: 协方差矩阵描述数据怎样散开：<bookmark mark='c'/>对角线上，是每个坐标变化多少；对角线外，是两个坐标一起变化多少。沿一个单位方向的散布，正是协方差的瑞利商，所以散得最开的方向，就是最大特征值的特征向量。<bookmark mark='a'/>这就是主成分，皮尔逊在1901年、霍特林在1933年提出。<bookmark mark='b'/>只留下最前面几个，我们就是这样把GPT-2的词画在三维里的。

b6c641161ee2.en: Chapter six. Power iteration: how a computer finds an eigenvector.
b6c641161ee2.zh: 第6章。幂迭代：计算机怎样找到特征向量。

8e1fd7fd30d1.en: Eigenvalues are roots of a polynomial, of degree 768 for a 768 by 768 matrix, and since Abel there is no formula beyond degree four. So computers iterate. <bookmark mark='a'/> Start anywhere, multiply by A, rescale to length one, repeat. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each multiplication favours the direction A stretches most, and the arrow swings onto the top eigenvector.
8e1fd7fd30d1.zh: 特征值是一个多项式的根，768乘768的矩阵，多项式就是768次的；而从阿贝尔起，我们知道四次以上没有求根公式。所以计算机只能迭代。<bookmark mark='a'/>从任意一点出发，乘A，缩放到长度1，重复。<bookmark mark='b'/>每乘一次，都偏向A拉伸得最多的方向，箭头就转到了最大特征值的特征向量上。

7ba208af3741.en: Now real matrices. <bookmark mark='a'/> The covariance of GPT-2's 50,257 token vectors, 768 by 768: its top two eigenvalues have a ratio of 0.455, and the error falls by 0.451 per step, down to the machine's rounding. The random start was almost perpendicular to the answer, a sine of 0.9996; chapter fourteen explains why. <bookmark mark='b'/> Part 1's letter table: a ratio of 0.218, and measured, 0.219. <bookmark mark='c'/> Dashed, the prediction: both match the prediction to two decimal places.
7ba208af3741.zh: 现在看真实的矩阵。<bookmark mark='a'/>GPT-2那50257个词元向量的协方差，768乘768：它最大的两个特征值之比是0.455，误差每一步缩小到0.451倍，一直降到机器的舍入误差。随机的起点几乎垂直于答案，正弦是0.9996；第14章会解释原因。<bookmark mark='b'/>第1部分的字母表：比值是0.218，实测0.219。<bookmark mark='c'/>虚线是预测：两者都和预测吻合到小数点后两位。

a3db6035a7de.en: The method is from 1929, by Richard von Mises and Hilda Pollaczek-Geiringer. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1998 it ranked the web: PageRank is the top eigenvector of a matrix of links. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2018, spectral normalization ran one power step per training step to keep layers from stretching too much. <bookmark mark='c'/> And today's library routines are its refinement: Krylov methods, after Cornelius Lanczos in 1950.
a3db6035a7de.zh: 这个方法出自1929年，作者是理查德·冯·米泽斯和希尔达·波拉切克-盖林格。<bookmark mark='a'/>1998年，它给整个网络排了名：PageRank就是链接矩阵最大特征值的特征向量。<bookmark mark='b'/>2018年，谱归一化每个训练步只做一步幂迭代，防止各层拉伸过度。<bookmark mark='c'/>今天程序库里的例程，是它的改进版：克雷洛夫方法，源于科尼利厄斯·兰乔斯1950年的工作。

0a8f9a1d8042.en: Chapter seven. The singular value decomposition.

d233554528e2.en: The stretches are the singular values. <bookmark mark='a'/> The unit circle always becomes an ellipse, and the singular values are its half-axes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sweep a unit vector all the way around, and watch how long its image is. The longest it ever gets is sigma one: the most the matrix can stretch any vector. It's called the spectral norm.
d233554528e2.zh: 这些拉伸倍数，就是奇异值。<bookmark mark='a'/>单位圆总是变成一个椭圆，奇异值就是它的半轴。<bookmark mark='b'/>让一个单位向量转一整圈，看它的像有多长。最长的时候就是σ1：矩阵能把任何向量拉伸的最大倍数。这叫谱范数。

8192af5954cb.en: Chapter eight. The best low-rank copy of a matrix.
8192af5954cb.zh: 第8章。一个矩阵最好的低秩副本。

efe778df2fda.en: Written out, the decomposition makes any matrix a sum of simple pieces, <bookmark mark='a'/> each a column times a row, weighted by a singular value. The number of pieces is the rank; a low-rank table is one a few pieces build. <bookmark mark='b'/> Keep the k biggest and you get the closest matrix of rank k. Nothing else comes closer: the Eckart-Young theorem, from 1936.
efe778df2fda.zh: 把分解写开，任何矩阵都是一些简单的块之和，<bookmark mark='a'/>每一块是一列乘一行，再乘一个奇异值。块的个数就是秩；低秩的表，就是几块就能拼出来的表。<bookmark mark='b'/>留下最大的k块，就得到最接近的秩为k的矩阵。没有别的更接近：这就是埃卡特–杨定理，1936年。

2a97aad871ec.en: Why can't anything beat them? <bookmark mark='a'/> Weyl's inequality, from 1912: A's singular values, shifted by k, are at most those of A minus B plus the k plus first of B. <bookmark mark='b'/> If B has rank k, that last term is zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> A matrix's squared size equals the sum of its squared singular values, as chapter nine shows, so B's error is at least the tail of A's. <bookmark mark='d'/> Keeping the top k achieves exactly that tail.
2a97aad871ec.zh: 为什么没有更好的？<bookmark mark='a'/>外尔1912年的不等式：A的奇异值往后挪k位，至多等于A减B的奇异值，加上B的第k加1个奇异值。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果B的秩是k，最后那一项就是0。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个矩阵大小的平方，等于它奇异值平方的和，第9章会说明，所以B的误差，至少是A的奇异值尾巴。<bookmark mark='d'/>留下前k块，正好达到这条尾巴。

60f584a7381b.en: A picture is a matrix too: 180 rows of 288 grey levels. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its best rank-one copy is a column times a row: stripes, the sky and the horizon. <bookmark mark='b'/> Rank two, four, eight: the mountains appear. Rank 8 keeps 99.6 percent of the squared size with 7 percent of the numbers. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then the trees; by rank 64 it is hard to tell from the original. <bookmark mark='d'/> And each error is exactly the singular values left out.
60f584a7381b.zh: 一张图片也是一个矩阵：180行，每行288个灰度值。<bookmark mark='a'/>它最好的秩1副本是一列乘一行：条纹、天空和地平线。<bookmark mark='b'/>秩2、4、8：山出现了。秩8用7%的数，留住了99.6%的平方大小。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后是树；到了秩64，就很难和原图区分了。<bookmark mark='d'/>每一处的误差，都正好是略去的奇异值。

a5cfbe55a3c7.en: Part 1's table of letter pairs, 26 by 26. <bookmark mark='a'/> The first piece alone is the table you'd get if the next letter ignored the one before. <bookmark mark='b'/> Add the second, third, fifth, tenth, <bookmark mark='c'/> and the error falls by exactly the singular values left out: 0.56 of the whole after one piece, 0.40 after two.
a5cfbe55a3c7.zh: 第1部分的字母对表，26乘26。<bookmark mark='a'/>光第一块，就是假如下一个字母不管前一个字母时会得到的表。<bookmark mark='b'/>加上第二块、第三块、第五块、第十块，<bookmark mark='c'/>误差正好按略去的奇异值减小：一块之后是全体的0.56，两块之后是0.40。

4048b69e4ac3.en: The pieces mean something. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take the table's departure from independence: each count against what you'd expect if letters ignored their neighbours. Spread the letters along its strongest direction. <bookmark mark='b'/> At one end: i, a, o, u, e. No one told the computer what a vowel is. From counts alone, it found that vowels and consonants take turns.
4048b69e4ac3.zh: 这些块是有意义的。<bookmark mark='a'/>看这张表偏离独立的程度：每个计数，对比字母互不相干时应有的计数。把字母沿它最强的方向排开。<bookmark mark='b'/>一端是：i，a, o, u, e。没有人告诉计算机什么是元音。只靠计数，它发现了元音和辅音轮流出现。

76349a72c16f.en: Low rank is everywhere in machine learning. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1990, latent semantic analysis searched documents by meaning with a truncated SVD. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2021, LoRA fine-tuned huge models by learning a low-rank change to each weight: for GPT-3, ten thousand times fewer numbers to train. <bookmark mark='c'/> In 2024, DeepSeek squeezed attention's keys and values through a low-rank bottleneck. Parts 15 and 27 build these.
76349a72c16f.zh: 低秩在机器学习里无处不在。<bookmark mark='a'/>1990年，潜在语义分析用截断的奇异值分解，按意义检索文档。<bookmark mark='b'/>2021年，LoRA只学习每个权重的一个低秩变化，就微调了巨大的模型：对GPT-3，要训练的数少了一万倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>2024年，DeepSeek让注意力的键和值穿过一个低秩瓶颈。第15和第27部分会搭建它们。

2fae64cd0362.en: Chapter nine. How big is a matrix?

3ca49d6bddb5.en: A matrix has two natural sizes. <bookmark mark='a'/> The Frobenius norm treats it as a list of numbers: the root of the sum of squares. The spectral norm treats it as a map: the most it stretches any vector, the top singular value. <bookmark mark='b'/> The squared Frobenius norm is the trace of A transpose A, <bookmark mark='c'/> and the trace is the sum of the eigenvalues, the squared singular values: chapter eight's missing step. <bookmark mark='d'/> So the spectral norm is at most the Frobenius norm, which is at most root r times it. <bookmark mark='e'/> Their squared ratio, the stable rank, counts how many directions carry the size.
3ca49d6bddb5.zh: 一个矩阵有两种自然的大小。<bookmark mark='a'/>弗罗贝尼乌斯范数把它当成一串数：各数平方和的平方根。谱范数把它当成一个映射：它把任何向量拉伸的最大倍数，也就是最大奇异值。<bookmark mark='b'/>弗罗贝尼乌斯范数的平方，是A转置A的迹，<bookmark mark='c'/>而迹是特征值之和，也就是奇异值的平方和：这正是第8章缺的那一步。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以谱范数至多是弗罗贝尼乌斯范数，后者又至多是前者的根号r倍。<bookmark mark='e'/>两者之比的平方叫稳定秩，数的是有多少个方向承载着矩阵的大小。

c8a6bd689bf3.en: Here are the stable ranks of GPT-2's 48 block matrices; each could reach 768. <bookmark mark='a'/> A random matrix of the MLP's shape has 345; theory predicts 341. <bookmark mark='b'/> The trained ones run from 7 to 131: every one of them far below a random matrix of the same shape. Training concentrates a matrix's size in a few directions.
c8a6bd689bf3.zh: 这是GPT-2各层48个矩阵的稳定秩；每个最多可以到768。<bookmark mark='a'/>和MLP同样形状的随机矩阵是345；理论预测341。<bookmark mark='b'/>训练过的矩阵在7到131之间：每一个都远低于同样形状的随机矩阵。训练把一个矩阵的大小，集中到了少数几个方向上。

b025ed1f8cf5.en: Norms multiply through a network. <bookmark mark='a'/> Stretching by A then B stretches by at most the product. Push a vector through 40 random layers. <bookmark mark='b'/> At a stretch of 1.2 per layer, its length grows 2,116 times. <bookmark mark='c'/> At 0.8, it shrinks to 0.00015. Only near one does the signal survive: Part 9's subject.
b025ed1f8cf5.zh: 范数在网络里一层层相乘。<bookmark mark='a'/>先按A拉伸再按B拉伸，至多拉伸两者的乘积。让一个向量穿过40层随机矩阵。<bookmark mark='b'/>每层拉伸1.2倍，它的长度增长到2116倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>每层0.8倍，就缩到0.00015。只有接近1，信号才能活下来：这是第9部分的主题。

c6d4dbf4cde2.en: The largest stretch over the smallest is the condition number: how much a matrix can amplify errors. <bookmark mark='a'/> Solve A x equals b with a small error in b. <bookmark mark='b'/> The error in x is at most that error over the smallest singular value, <bookmark mark='c'/> and b is at most the largest times x. <bookmark mark='d'/> Divide: relative errors grow by at most kappa. <bookmark mark='e'/> A computer's rounding plays the error in b. At a condition number of a million, 64-bit arithmetic loses about ten to the minus 11 of the answer; 32-bit, ten to the minus 3. From a condition number of ten to the 9, the 32-bit answer is no answer at all. GPT-2's worst-conditioned matrix reaches about ten to the 5.
c6d4dbf4cde2.zh: 最大拉伸除以最小拉伸，就是条件数：一个矩阵能把误差放大多少。<bookmark mark='a'/>解A x等于b，b里有一个小误差。<bookmark mark='b'/>x的误差，至多是这个误差除以最小奇异值，<bookmark mark='c'/>而b至多是最大奇异值乘x。<bookmark mark='d'/>相除：相对误差至多放大κ倍。<bookmark mark='e'/>计算机的舍入，就扮演b里的误差。条件数为一百万时，64位运算大约丢掉答案的10的负11次方；32位丢掉10的负3次方。条件数到了10的9次方，32位的答案就根本不算答案了。GPT-2条件最差的矩阵，大约达到10的5次方。

2fb2c8883c76.en: Chapter ten. Random matrices, and what training writes into a network's weights.
2fb2c8883c76.zh: 第10章。随机矩阵，以及训练往网络权重里写进了什么。

8dfad640ba8c.en: What does pure noise look like, through its eigenvalues? <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1955 Eugene Wigner modelled heavy nuclei's energy levels with a random matrix's eigenvalues, and found a law. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 1967 Marchenko and Pastur found it for rectangular matrices: the eigenvalues of W W transpose over M fill a fixed interval, in a fixed shape, set by the aspect ratio alone. We'll check it rather than prove it. <bookmark mark='c'/> A random 768 by 3,072 matrix, GPT-2's MLP shape: 768 eigenvalues, <bookmark mark='d'/> and the law on top. Not one eigenvalue escapes it.
8dfad640ba8c.zh: 纯粹的噪声，从特征值看是什么样？<bookmark mark='a'/>1955年，尤金·维格纳用随机矩阵的特征值，模拟重原子核的能级，发现了一条定律。<bookmark mark='b'/>1967年，马尔琴科和帕斯图尔找到了长方形矩阵的定律：W乘W转置除以M的特征值，填满一个固定的区间，形状也固定，只由长宽比决定。我们不证明它，而是检验它。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个768乘3072的随机矩阵，和GPT-2的MLP同样形状：768个特征值，<bookmark mark='d'/>上面画着这条定律。没有一个特征值跑出去。

3b22da7331b0.en: Now a trained matrix: GPT-2's layer 6, the first matrix of its MLP, scaled the same way. <bookmark mark='a'/> Most eigenvalues sit in a bulk much like the law. <bookmark mark='b'/> But 59 have escaped beyond the edge, the largest 8.7 times past it. <bookmark mark='c'/> Just unusual values? Shuffle the same numbers into random places. The escapees vanish: the spectrum falls back onto the law. The information is in the arrangement: a few strong directions, learned.
3b22da7331b0.zh: 再看一个训练过的矩阵：GPT-2第6层，它MLP的第一个矩阵，按同样的方式缩放。<bookmark mark='a'/>大多数特征值落在一个主体里，形状很像这条定律。<bookmark mark='b'/>但有59个跑出了边界，最大的超出边界8.7倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>只是因为数值特别吗？把同样这些数打乱，放到随机的位置。跑出去的特征值消失了：谱又落回了这条定律。信息在排列里：学到的几个强方向。

2c2a6dc1535d.en: The same in this series' small novels model. <bookmark mark='a'/> At initialization its 30 matrices are random: 1 escapees in all. <bookmark mark='b'/> After training, every matrix has between 13 and 31 beyond the edge. Training writes a little structure into a sea of noise.
2c2a6dc1535d.zh: 这个系列在小说上训练的小模型，也是一样。<bookmark mark='a'/>初始化时，它的30个矩阵是随机的：总共1个特征值越界。<bookmark mark='b'/>训练之后，每个矩阵都有13到31个落在边界之外。训练在一片噪声的海洋里，写下了一点结构。

1941d75e5f25.en: Chapter eleven. Gradients are low rank.

4215506ed838.en: Here is a real gradient, from a small transformer trained on the novels: one 336 by 128 matrix. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its singular values, largest first, on a log scale. At the first step they fall slowly. <bookmark mark='b'/> A few steps in, they collapse: at step 50, the top eight directions carry 100.0 percent of the gradient. <bookmark mark='c'/> Later the spectrum fills in, slowly: at step 600, the top eight still carry 84 percent, of 128 directions.
4215506ed838.zh: 这是一个真实的梯度，来自一个在小说上训练的小Transformer：一个336乘128的矩阵。<bookmark mark='a'/>它的奇异值，从大到小，对数坐标。第一步时，它们下降得很慢。<bookmark mark='b'/>几步之后就塌了下去：到第50步，前八个方向承载了梯度的100.0%。<bookmark mark='c'/>后来谱又慢慢填回来：到第600步，前八个方向仍然承载着84%，而方向一共有128个。

0d49738d99b1.en: That is GaLore's idea, from Jiawei Zhao, Anima Anandkumar, Yuandong Tian and colleagues in 2024. Adam keeps two running averages per weight: fourteen billion extra numbers for a seven-billion-parameter model. <bookmark mark='a'/> GaLore projects each gradient onto its top r singular directions <bookmark mark='b'/> and runs Adam there, refreshing the directions now and then. <bookmark mark='c'/> For our model: 778,240 numbers with Adam, 235,520 at rank 32, 58,880 at rank 8. At scale the paper reports up to 65 percent less optimizer memory, and, with 8-bit states, a seven-billion-parameter model pretrained on one 24-gigabyte card.
0d49738d99b1.zh: 这就是GaLore的想法，来自Jiawei Zhao、阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔、田渊栋和同事，2024年。Adam为每个权重保存两个滑动平均：一个70亿参数的模型，就多出140亿个数。<bookmark mark='a'/>GaLore把每个梯度投影到它前r个奇异方向上，<bookmark mark='b'/>在那里运行Adam，每隔一段时间更新这些方向。<bookmark mark='c'/>对我们的模型：Adam要保存778240个数，秩32时235520个，秩8时58880个。在大规模上，论文报告优化器内存最多减少65%，而且配合8位状态，在一张24GB的显卡上预训练了一个70亿参数的模型。

8c1ef0c10516.en: Does a narrow window cost anything? We trained the model with Adam and with GaLore at ranks 32 and 8, each at its best of three learning rates, three seeds each. <bookmark mark='a'/> The training curves, averaged. <bookmark mark='b'/> The held-out loss: Adam 5.195, rank 32 4.901, rank 8 4.949. <bookmark mark='c'/> GaLore wins, but most of the gap, 73 percent, comes from GaLore's smaller steps for the matrices, which let the rest train at the full rate: Adam given the same step sizes reaches 4.979. The low-rank window adds the rest here, at no cost.
8c1ef0c10516.zh: 窄窗口有代价吗？我们用Adam，以及秩32和秩8的GaLore训练这个模型，每种都在三个学习率里取最好的，各跑三个随机种子。<bookmark mark='a'/>训练曲线，取平均。<bookmark mark='b'/>留出数据上的损失：Adam 5.195，秩32 4.901，秩8 4.949。<bookmark mark='c'/>GaLore胜出，但差距的大部分，也就是73%，来自GaLore给矩阵更小的步长，好让其余部分以完整的学习率训练：给Adam同样的步长，它达到4.979。剩下的差距来自低秩窗口，而且没有代价。

b01a25483480.en: Compare LoRA, Part 27's tool. <bookmark mark='a'/> LoRA fixes the change to the weights at rank r for good. <bookmark mark='b'/> GaLore makes each step low rank, but the window moves. <bookmark mark='c'/> After 600 steps, the total change to one matrix has an effective rank of 25 with the rank-8 window, against 78 for Adam: so its total change is far richer than rank 8. That is GaLore's answer to LoRA's limit; Part 27 uses LoRA where a small change is all that's wanted.
b01a25483480.zh: 对比一下第27部分的工具LoRA。<bookmark mark='a'/>LoRA把权重的变化永远固定在秩r。<bookmark mark='b'/>GaLore让每一步是低秩的，但窗口会移动。<bookmark mark='c'/>600步之后，一个矩阵的总变化，用秩8窗口时有效秩是25，Adam是78：所以它的总变化远比秩8丰富。这是GaLore对LoRA局限的回答；只需要一点小改动的时候，第27部分就用LoRA。

311e16ae0f2b.en: Chapter twelve. Word vectors, from counting.
311e16ae0f2b.zh: 第12章。从计数得到词向量。

e2a4152aecf8.en: Part 1's counting model treated every word as an island. The fix is an old idea from linguistics. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1954 Zellig Harris argued that words in the same contexts tend to mean similar things. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 1957 John Firth: you shall know a word by the company it keeps. <bookmark mark='c'/> In 1990 Scott Deerwester, Susan Dumais and colleagues made it an algorithm: count words in documents, take the SVD, and search by meaning rather than spelling.
e2a4152aecf8.zh: 第1部分的计数模型，把每个词都当成一座孤岛。办法来自语言学里的一个老想法。<bookmark mark='a'/>1954年，泽利格·哈里斯指出，出现在相同上下文里的词，意思往往相近。<bookmark mark='b'/>1957年，约翰·弗斯说：要了解一个词，就看它和什么词为伴。<bookmark mark='c'/>1990年，斯科特·迪尔韦斯特、苏珊·杜迈斯和同事把它变成了算法：数一数词在文档里出现的次数，做奇异值分解，按意义而不是按拼写来检索。

07d05d528821.en: Keep the table's hundred strongest directions, with the SVD. <bookmark mark='a'/> Every word gets a hundred numbers. <bookmark mark='b'/> Words that keep the same company end up close. Monday: saturday, tuesday, sunday. Three: four, two, five. Dog: devil, dogs, sheep. Ship: pequod, boat, sail. Perezvon is a dog in The Brothers Karamazov, and the Pequod is Ahab's ship. Nobody gave it a dictionary.
07d05d528821.zh: 用奇异值分解，留下这张表最强的一百个方向。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个词得到一百个数。<bookmark mark='b'/>与相同的词为伴的词，最后靠得很近。星期一的近邻是：saturday, tuesday, sunday。数字三的近邻是：four, two, five。狗和船也各自找到了同伴。Perezvon是《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》里的一条狗，Pequod是亚哈船长的船。没有人给它一本词典。

6cd101766e2a.en: How many directions does meaning need? Keep only the strongest few. <bookmark mark='a'/> With 2, only 0 of these twenty neighbours are final ones. <bookmark mark='b'/> With 5, <bookmark mark='c'/> 10, <bookmark mark='d'/> 25, <bookmark mark='e'/> and all 100. three settles first, with 5 directions; monday needs 100. The strongest directions carry the broad patterns; finer meanings live further down.
6cd101766e2a.zh: 意义需要多少个方向？只留下最强的几个。<bookmark mark='a'/>只留2个时，这二十个近邻里，只有0个是最终的近邻。<bookmark mark='b'/>留5个，<bookmark mark='c'/>10个，<bookmark mark='d'/>25个，<bookmark mark='e'/>以及全部100个。three最先定下来，用了5个方向；monday要100个。最强的方向承载大的格局；细致的意义在更后面。

a013d6cc6c54.en: Directions mean something too. <bookmark mark='a'/> Step from France to Paris, then take the same step from England. <bookmark mark='b'/> The nearest word to where you land is London. Man is to king as woman is to: duke, then queen. <bookmark mark='c'/> On 710 such questions built from the books, man and woman, dog and dogs, walk and walked, the nearest word is right 41 percent of the time, out of ten thousand candidates. And of each category word's five nearest neighbours, animals, colours, numbers and so on, 87 percent share its category, against 14 percent by chance.
a013d6cc6c54.zh: 方向也有意义。<bookmark mark='a'/>从法国走到巴黎，再从英国出发，走同样的一步。<bookmark mark='b'/>落点最近的词，正是伦敦。男人之于国王，正如女人之于：duke，然后是queen。<bookmark mark='c'/>我们从书里的词对，比如男和女、单数和复数、现在时和过去时，造了710道这样的题，最近的词有41%是对的，候选词有一万个。而每个类别词的五个最近邻里，动物、颜色、数字等等，有87%属于同一类别，碰运气只有14%。

0bc10fc7b6be.en: Chapter thirteen. Word2vec, which turns out to be counting in disguise.
0bc10fc7b6be.zh: 第13章。word2vec，原来是换了个样子的计数。

3b61216e8005.en: We trained it on the novels, with the same words and window as the counting. Four words and their nearest neighbours, with the loss below. <bookmark mark='a'/> At the start, random. <bookmark mark='b'/> After 36 steps, the neighbours are the commonest words: they get pushed first. <bookmark mark='c'/> By step 1,089, meaning appears: three sits with thirty, fifty, four. <bookmark mark='d'/> By the end, Monday sits with Tuesday, and father with son. Nothing told it what a day or a relative is.
3b61216e8005.zh: 我们在小说上训练它，用和计数时一样的词和窗口。四个词和它们的最近邻，下面是损失。<bookmark mark='a'/>开始时是随机的。<bookmark mark='b'/>36步之后，近邻都是最常见的词：它们最先被推动。<bookmark mark='c'/>到第1089步，意义出现了：three和thirty, fifty, four在一起。<bookmark mark='d'/>到最后，monday和Tuesday在一起，father和son在一起。没有任何东西告诉它，什么是一天，什么是亲戚。

dff098a8208c.en: Let's check it on the 300 commonest words, where the loss can be minimized completely. <bookmark mark='a'/> With 300 numbers per vector, every dot product is free: they land on the shifted PMI, a median error of 0.001. <bookmark mark='b'/> With 30, the points spread: 0.18. <bookmark mark='c'/> With 5, 0.22. A short vector holds only a low-rank version of the table.
dff098a8208c.zh: 来检验一下，用最常见的300个词，这时损失可以完全最小化。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个向量300个数时，每个点积都是自由的：它们落在平移后的点互信息上，中位误差0.001。<bookmark mark='b'/>30个数时，点散开了：0.18。<bookmark mark='c'/>5个数时，0.22。短的向量，只能装下这张表的一个低秩版本。

db6b5db4cd0b.en: And the real run, ten thousand words with a hundred numbers each? <bookmark mark='a'/> For the 6,251 pairs it saw at least 50 times: trained dot product against the shifted PMI of its own training pairs. <bookmark mark='b'/> Correlation 0.96, slope 0.98. They agree closely, though the low rank pulls the extremes toward the middle.
db6b5db4cd0b.zh: 那么真实的训练，一万个词，每个一百个数呢？<bookmark mark='a'/>对它至少见过50次的6251个词对：训练出的点积，对比它自己训练数据里的平移点互信息。<bookmark mark='b'/>相关系数0.96，斜率0.98。两者吻合得很好，只是低秩把两头往中间拉了一些。

21a8b8a3c953.en: Which is better? <bookmark mark='a'/> On our analogy questions, counting gets 41 percent and word2vec 30. On analogies the counting method does better. On category neighbours, 87 against 83. Levy, Goldberg and Dagan found in 2015 that, tuned with equal care, the two families are close. <bookmark mark='b'/> GloVe, in 2014, fitted the log counts directly. <bookmark mark='c'/> All of these give one vector per word: bank by a river and bank with money share one. Parts 13 and 14 make vectors depend on context.
21a8b8a3c953.zh: 哪个更好？<bookmark mark='a'/>在我们的类比题上，计数得到41%，word2vec是30%。在类比题上，计数的方法更好。在类别近邻上，87对83。列维、戈德堡和达根在2015年发现，用同样的细心调参，两类方法相差无几。<bookmark mark='b'/>2014年的GloVe，直接拟合计数的对数。<bookmark mark='c'/>这些方法都给每个词一个向量：河岸的bank和银行的bank共用一个。第13和第14部分让向量随上下文变化。

6297b8cd2e4f.en: Chapter fourteen. Life in seven hundred and sixty-eight dimensions.

59a1ab8681bf.en: Why? <bookmark mark='a'/> The cosine is the dot product over the lengths, each close to root d, as we'll see. <bookmark mark='b'/> The dot product is a sum of d independent products of mean zero and variance one: variance d. <bookmark mark='c'/> Divide by d squared: the cosine's variance is one over d. <bookmark mark='d'/> Measured from d of 2 to 4096, the points sit on the line; at 768, 0.00128 against 0.00130.
59a1ab8681bf.zh: 为什么？<bookmark mark='a'/>余弦是点积除以两个长度，而每个长度都接近根号d，后面会看到。<bookmark mark='b'/>点积是d个独立乘积之和，每个均值为0、方差为1：方差是d。<bookmark mark='c'/>除以d的平方：余弦的方差是d分之1。<bookmark mark='d'/>从d等于2到4096实测，点都落在线上；在768维，0.00128，对比0.00130。

c4c70ffde3db.en: So high-dimensional space is roomy. <bookmark mark='a'/> Ten thousand random directions in 768 dimensions: every pair between 79 and 101 degrees apart. <bookmark mark='b'/> A model stores an idea, a feature, as a direction, and can keep far more features than dimensions if they need only be nearly perpendicular: superposition, how Part 30 reads a model.
c4c70ffde3db.zh: 所以高维空间很宽敞。<bookmark mark='a'/>768维里一万个随机方向：每一对的夹角都在79到101度之间。<bookmark mark='b'/>模型把一个概念，也就是一个特征，存成一个方向；只要这些方向近似垂直就行，特征就可以远多于维数：这叫叠加，第30部分就靠它读懂模型。

6da228bb9f10.en: Volume is stranger. It grows like the radius to the d, so the inner ball with 99 percent of the radius holds 0.99 to the d of the volume. <bookmark mark='a'/> In three dimensions, the outer one percent holds 3.0 percent. In a hundred, 63.4. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 768, 99.96 percent: a high-dimensional ball is nearly all skin.
6da228bb9f10.zh: 体积更奇怪。它按半径的d次方增长，所以半径为99%的内球，只占体积的0.99的d次方。<bookmark mark='a'/>在三维，最外面百分之一的壳占体积的3.0%。在一百维，63.4%。<bookmark mark='b'/>在768维，99.96%：一个高维的球，几乎全是皮。

a2589797b1cf.en: Chapter fifteen. How few numbers can keep the distances?
a2589797b1cf.zh: 第15章。最少要多少个数，才能保住距离？

2a9437cad50a.en: A consequence that sounds impossible. <bookmark mark='a'/> Multiply a thousand of GPT-2's vectors by one random matrix, crushing 768 numbers to a few. <bookmark mark='b'/> Down to 2, distances are scrambled; 5, 20: better. <bookmark mark='c'/> At 100, 84 percent of the distances move by less than ten percent; at 400, 99.6 percent.
2a9437cad50a.zh: 一个听起来不可能的推论。<bookmark mark='a'/>把GPT-2的一千个向量乘上同一个随机矩阵，把768个数压成几个。<bookmark mark='b'/>压到2个，距离全乱了；5个、20个：好一些。<bookmark mark='c'/>到100个，有84%的距离变化不到10%；到400个，99.6%。

2e921fcb25b8.en: Fix one pair, and let x be their difference, of length one. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each coordinate of R x is a sum of independent normals: normal, with variance one. <bookmark mark='b'/> The squared length is a sum of k such squares: chi-squared, mean k. <bookmark mark='c'/> The Chernoff trick: Markov's inequality on e to the t times it, whose average we know. <bookmark mark='d'/> The best t, and a bound on the logarithm: the chance of stretching past epsilon falls exponentially in k, and shrinking likewise. <bookmark mark='e'/> The union bound over all pairs: once k reaches four log n over that small quantity, the chance of any failure is below one. A good projection exists, and a random one works with probability at least one over n.
2e921fcb25b8.zh: 固定一对点，令x是它们的差，长度为1。<bookmark mark='a'/>R x的每个坐标，都是一些独立正态数之和：仍是正态的，方差为1。<bookmark mark='b'/>长度的平方是k个这样的平方之和：卡方分布，均值为k。<bookmark mark='c'/>切尔诺夫的技巧：对e的t倍它次方用马尔可夫不等式，而它的平均值我们确切知道。<bookmark mark='d'/>选最好的t，再估计对数：拉长超过ε的概率随k指数下降，缩短也一样。<bookmark mark='e'/>对所有点对用联合界：一旦k达到4 log n除以那个小量，出任何差错的概率都小于1。好的投影一定存在，而随机的投影至少以n分之1的概率成功。

461cb08ddc99.en: Now the data. <bookmark mark='a'/> For one pair, the chance of moving more than 10 percent is exactly a chi-squared tail, in yellow. <bookmark mark='b'/> The measured share of all 499,500 pairs sits on it: the largest gap is 0.0020. <bookmark mark='c'/> The Chernoff bound, dashed, lies above, as it must: at 768, 0.33 against an exact 0.050.
461cb08ddc99.zh: 现在看数据。<bookmark mark='a'/>对一对点，变化超过10%的概率，正好是一个卡方尾巴，黄色那条。<bookmark mark='b'/>全部499500对点的实测比例就落在它上面：最大的差距是0.0020。<bookmark mark='c'/>虚线的切尔诺夫界在上方，它本该如此：在768维，是0.33，而精确值是0.050。

c867c49a98de.en: Random directions in 768 dimensions are nearly perpendicular, cosines of zero give or take 0.036. Trained vectors are not random. <bookmark mark='a'/> Between two of GPT-2's token vectors the average cosine is 0.24: they all lean one way, the space is anisotropic. Each makes a cosine of 0.49, on average, with their mean. <bookmark mark='b'/> Subtract the mean, and the average cosine falls to 0.010.
c867c49a98de.zh: 768维里的随机方向几乎垂直，余弦是0，上下浮动0.036。可训练出的向量不是随机的。<bookmark mark='a'/>GPT-2两个词元向量之间，平均余弦是0.24：它们都往同一边歪，这个空间是各向异性的。每个向量和全体的均值之间，平均余弦是0.49。<bookmark mark='b'/>减去均值，平均余弦降到0.010。

10064880eee6.en: Even centred, the spread is uneven. <bookmark mark='a'/> The top principal direction carries 1.8 percent of it, against 0.13 for an even share. <bookmark mark='b'/> Colour each token by its number in GPT-2's vocabulary, which roughly runs from frequent to rare: the first direction tracks it, a rank correlation of 0.62. <bookmark mark='c'/> Jun Gao and colleagues explained this in 2019: training mostly pushes a rare token's vector away from contexts, so rare tokens drift together. Removing the top direction too, Mu and Viswanath's all-but-the-top of 2018, brings the average cosine from 0.010 to 0.0009.
10064880eee6.zh: 即使中心化了，散布也不均匀。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一主方向承载了1.8%的散布，均匀分配只有0.13%。<bookmark mark='b'/>按每个词元在GPT-2词表里的编号着色，编号大致从常见排到罕见：第一个方向跟着它走，秩相关系数0.62。<bookmark mark='c'/>Jun Gao和同事在2019年解释了这一点：训练主要把罕见词元的向量推离各种上下文，于是罕见的词元漂到了一起。连第一个方向也去掉，也就是Mu和Viswanath 2018年的“去掉顶部方向”，平均余弦从0.010降到0.0009。

ca2a3731825b.en: Inside the network it is stronger. <bookmark mark='a'/> GPT-2 reading the scoreboard's passage, layer by layer: the average cosine between positions is 0.13 at the input, about 0.38 in the middle, and 0.94 at the top, the narrow cone Kawin Ethayarajh measured in 2019. <bookmark mark='b'/> In layer 6, three of 768 dimensions carry 64 percent of it: rogue dimensions, in Timkey and van Schijndel's phrase. <bookmark mark='c'/> Centre each layer and the cosines fall to about zero. Raw cosines measure this common lean as much as meaning.
ca2a3731825b.zh: 在网络内部，这个现象更强。<bookmark mark='a'/>让GPT-2读记分牌的测试段落，一层一层看：不同位置之间的平均余弦，在输入处是0.13，中间大约0.38，顶层是0.94，这就是卡温·埃塔亚拉赫2019年测到的窄锥。<bookmark mark='b'/>在第6层，768维里只有三个维度，就承载了它的64%：蒂姆基和范施尼德尔称之为离群维度。<bookmark mark='c'/>每层中心化之后，余弦降到0附近。原始的余弦，量到的这种共同的倾斜，和意义一样多。

601e349fff02.en: Lopsided or not, directions carry meaning: our counted vectors sent England to london. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2013 Mikolov, Yih and Zweig found such regularities in neural word vectors. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2022 Nelson Elhage and colleagues showed toy networks storing more features than dimensions, as nearly perpendicular directions. <bookmark mark='c'/> In 2024 Kiho Park, Yo Joong Choe and Victor Veitch made it precise: concepts as directions, under the right inner product, not always the plain dot product. <bookmark mark='d'/> Reading and steering along such directions is Part 30's subject.
601e349fff02.zh: 歪不歪斜，方向都承载着意义：我们计数得到的向量，把england送到了london。<bookmark mark='a'/>2013年，米科洛夫、Yih和Zweig在神经网络的词向量里，发现了同样的规律。<bookmark mark='b'/>2022年，纳尔逊·埃尔哈格和同事展示了小网络把比维数更多的特征，存成近似垂直的方向。<bookmark mark='c'/>2024年，Kiho Park、Yo Joong Choe和Victor Veitch把它说清楚了：概念就是方向，但要用对的内积，不一定是普通的点积。<bookmark mark='d'/>沿着这些方向读取和操控模型，是第30部分的主题。

0c8a61b7325b.en: Chapter seventeen. Low rank in the wild: recommendations and retrieval.
0c8a61b7325b.zh: 第17章。现实中的低秩：推荐与检索。

39857c475be2.en: Low rank's most famous test came from a DVD rental company. <bookmark mark='a'/> In October 2006 Netflix released a hundred million ratings, from 480,189 customers on 17,770 films, and offered a million dollars to predict held-out ratings ten percent better than its own system. <bookmark mark='b'/> The table was mostly empty: about two hundred ratings per customer. <bookmark mark='c'/> In December, a programmer writing as Simon Funk posted a short program that factorized it by gradient descent, and leapt up the leaderboard. In 2009 BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos won with a blend of hundreds of models, many of them refinements of that factorization.
39857c475be2.zh: 低秩最有名的一次检验，来自一家DVD租赁公司。<bookmark mark='a'/>2006年10月，Netflix公开了一亿条评分，来自480189位用户、17770部电影，悬赏一百万美元，谁能把留出评分预测得比它自己的系统好10%。<bookmark mark='b'/>这张表大半是空的：每位用户平均只有大约两百条评分。<bookmark mark='c'/>12月，一位署名西蒙·芬克的程序员贴出一个短程序，用梯度下降分解这张表，在排行榜上一跃而上。2009年，BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos队获胜，用的是几百个模型的组合，其中很多都是那种分解的改进版。

0ddea2c4f387.en: The model is a sum. <bookmark mark='a'/> An average, plus the user's generosity, plus the film's quality, plus a dot product of k numbers of taste each. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fit it to the ratings we have, keeping the vectors small. <bookmark mark='c'/> A full table would have chapter eight's answer; with holes there is no formula, and we descend the gradient. <bookmark mark='d'/> We built a small world to test on: 4,000 users, 1,200 films, 122,937 ratings, from six hidden genres the method never sees.
0ddea2c4f387.zh: 模型是一个和。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个平均分，加上用户的宽厚，加上电影的质量，再加上两个各有k个口味数的向量的点积。<bookmark mark='b'/>拟合已有的评分，同时让向量保持小。<bookmark mark='c'/>一张满的表，第8章就有答案；有空洞就没有公式，只能沿梯度下降。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们造了一个小世界来检验：4000位用户，1200部电影，122937条评分，来自六种隐藏的类型，方法本身看不到它们。

3eb09dc8bc5a.en: Training replayed, at rank 8. <bookmark mark='a'/> The error falls on the ratings it trains on, and on held-out ones: from 0.94 stars to 0.745. Without the penalty the held-out error bottoms out at 0.831 and climbs back to 0.858: the vectors memorize the training ratings. <bookmark mark='b'/> On the right, each film's vector, on its two strongest directions, coloured by the hidden genre, with each genre's average. <bookmark mark='c'/> The genres drift apart. Of each film's ten nearest films, 60 percent share its genre, against 19 percent by chance.
3eb09dc8bc5a.zh: 回放训练过程，秩为8。<bookmark mark='a'/>训练用的评分上误差在降，留出的评分上也在降：从0.94星降到0.745。没有惩罚项时，留出误差最低到0.831，又回升到0.858：向量把训练评分背了下来。<bookmark mark='b'/>右边，是每部电影的向量，画在它最强的两个方向上，按隐藏的类型着色，大圆点是每种类型的平均位置。<bookmark mark='c'/>类型渐渐分开了。每部电影最近的十部电影里，有60%和它同类型，碰运气只有19%。

57c40884c6fc.en: How much taste does it take? The average rating misses by 0.936 stars. <bookmark mark='a'/> Adding generosity and quality: 0.824. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then the taste vectors, rank one to thirty-two, three seeds each. The error is lowest at rank 8, 0.746, near the six genres we hid; beyond that, extra directions fit noise.
57c40884c6fc.zh: 口味需要多少个方向？只猜平均分，误差是0.936星。<bookmark mark='a'/>加上宽厚和质量：0.824。<bookmark mark='b'/>再加上口味向量，秩从1到32，各三个随机种子。误差在秩8时最低，0.746，接近我们藏进去的六种类型；再多的方向，拟合的就是噪声了。

4c04fb1c07f0.en: Factorization has a weakness: a new user has no vector. Today's recommenders use two towers. <bookmark mark='a'/> One network turns a user's history into a vector, another a film's details; the score is their dot product. <bookmark mark='b'/> Trained so each user's real films outscore the batch, corrected for popularity, the score learns a pointwise mutual information, chapter twelve's quantity; popularity is added back to recommend. <bookmark mark='c'/> The share of held-out favourites in the top ten reaches 0.11 for known users and 0.17 for new ones, from five films each; popularity alone gets 0.08 and 0.16. Both beat recommending the most popular films.
4c04fb1c07f0.zh: 矩阵分解有个弱点：新用户没有向量。今天的推荐系统用的是双塔。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个网络把用户的历史变成向量，另一个把电影的信息变成向量；分数就是它们的点积。<bookmark mark='b'/>训练让每位用户真正看过的电影，在一批里得分最高，再对热门程度做校正，这样分数学到的是点互信息，也就是第12章的那个量；推荐时再把热门程度加回去。<bookmark mark='c'/>留出的心头好落进前十的比例：已知用户0.11，新用户0.17，新用户各只给了五部电影；只按热门推荐，分别是0.08和0.16。两者都胜过只推荐最热门的电影。

135a041e426b.en: Retrieval is, at heart, one matrix product, and the art is not computing most of it. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2016 YouTube described recommending as a nearest-neighbour search among video vectors. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2017 Facebook's FAISS searched a billion vectors, on GPUs. <bookmark mark='c'/> In 2020 dense passage retrieval put questions and passages in one space, the way assistants now find what to read before answering. Part 29 puts it to work.
135a041e426b.zh: 检索说到底是一次矩阵乘法，而技巧在于大部分都不用算。<bookmark mark='a'/>2016年，YouTube把推荐描述成在视频向量之间找最近邻。<bookmark mark='b'/>2017年，Facebook的FAISS在GPU上搜索十亿个向量。<bookmark mark='c'/>2020年，稠密段落检索把问题和段落放进同一个空间，现在的助手回答之前，就是这样找到要读的东西。第29部分会用上它。

af72622c5524.en: Let's take stock. Vectors are lists of numbers with geometry; the dot product, kept honest by Cauchy-Schwarz, measures likeness. Einsum names the axes and counts the cost. Projections find the closest point, and arithmetic's order matters. Symmetric matrices stretch along perpendicular directions, which power iteration finds; every matrix is turn, stretch, turn, and its biggest pieces are its best low-rank copy. Trained weights and gradients live in a few strong directions. Counting and guessing factorize the same table. And in high dimensions, random directions are perpendicular, random projections keep distances, and low rank fills in empty tables.
af72622c5524.zh: 来总结一下。向量是带着几何的一串数；点积由柯西–施瓦茨保证，衡量相似程度。einsum给轴起名字，也数出计算量。投影找到最近的点，而运算的顺序很重要。对称矩阵沿互相垂直的方向拉伸，幂迭代能找到它们；每个矩阵都是转、拉、再转，最大的几块就是它最好的低秩副本。训练过的权重和梯度，都活在几个强方向上。计数和猜测，分解的是同一张表。而在高维里，随机方向互相垂直，随机投影保住距离，低秩能填满空着的表。

ffb7a13adc43.en: All of it comes back. Part 4 builds the chain rule that computes every gradient. Part 9 keeps each layer's stretch near one, so that deep networks train at all. Part 11 builds Muon, steepest descent in the spectral norm. Part 13 writes attention as dot products, in einsum. Part 15 squeezes a long context's memory through low rank, Part 27 fine-tunes through it, and Part 30 reads and steers the directions inside a model.
ffb7a13adc43.zh: 这些都会再出现。第4部分搭建计算每个梯度的链式法则。第9部分让每层的拉伸保持在1附近，深层网络才训练得动。第11部分搭建Muon，也就是谱范数下的最速下降。第13部分用einsum把注意力写成点积。第15部分让长上下文的记忆穿过低秩，第27部分通过它做微调，第30部分读取并操控模型内部的方向。

ea8e5650defb.en: Here are eight problems to try, from the triangle inequality to the Johnson-Lindenstrauss proof. Pause here, and work through them; full solutions are in this part's notes.
ea8e5650defb.zh: 这里有八道题，从三角不等式到约翰逊–林登斯特劳斯引理的证明。在这里暂停，自己做一做；完整的解答在这一部分的讲义里。

4b80a65b5547.en: Next time: change. Everything in this part stood still, except in the chapters that trained something, where we took gradients on trust. <bookmark mark='a'/> Part 4 builds derivatives, the chain rule, and the machine that runs it backwards through billions of numbers at once.
4b80a65b5547.zh: 下一次：变化。这一部分里，一切都是静止的，只有那几章训练了东西，而梯度我们是拿来就用的。<bookmark mark='a'/>第4部分会搭建导数、链式法则，以及让它反向穿过几十亿个数的那台机器。

34370483972f.en: For more, Gilbert Strang's Linear Algebra and Learning from Data is a friendly companion, Trefethen and Bau explain why the order of arithmetic matters, and Roman Vershynin's High-Dimensional Probability explains why big spaces behave the way they do. Thanks for watching, and see you in Part 4.
34370483972f.zh: 想深入的话，吉尔伯特·斯特朗的《线性代数与数据学习》是很友好的伙伴，特雷费森和鲍的书讲清了运算顺序为什么重要，罗曼·韦尔希宁的《高维概率》解释了大空间为什么这样表现。谢谢观看，第4部分见。

d2aee9f50450.en: Is that cosine always between minus one and one, even in 768 dimensions? That's the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality. <bookmark mark='a'/> For any number t, the length of a minus t b, squared, can't be negative. <bookmark mark='b'/> If b is zero, the inequality is immediate. Otherwise, expand it: a parabola in t. <bookmark mark='c'/> A parabola that never dips below zero has at most one root, so its discriminant can't be positive. <bookmark mark='d'/> Rearranged: the dot product is at most the product of the lengths. <bookmark mark='e'/> Turn b and watch: the parabola touches zero only when b lines up with a. So an angle between two words makes sense.
d2aee9f50450.zh: 这个余弦总在负1和1之间吗？哪怕在768维里？这就是柯西–施瓦茨不等式。<bookmark mark='a'/>对任何数t，a减t乘b的长度的平方，都不可能是负的。<bookmark mark='b'/> 如果b是零向量，不等式显然成立。否则，把它展开：一条关于t的抛物线。<bookmark mark='c'/>一条从不跌到0以下的抛物线，最多只有一个根，所以它的判别式不可能是正的。<bookmark mark='d'/>整理一下：点积至多是两个长度的乘积。<bookmark mark='e'/>转动b，看着：只有当b和a对齐时，抛物线才碰到0。所以两个词之间的夹角，是有意义的。

54c305f17244.en: Not every matrix is symmetric. Many aren't even square. <bookmark mark='a'/> But every matrix, without exception, has three factors: an orthogonal change of coordinates, a stretch or projection along the axes, and another orthogonal change. Those coordinate changes may rotate or reflect. Our example uses two rotations. <bookmark mark='b'/> That's the singular value decomposition: A equals U, Sigma, V transpose.
54c305f17244.zh: 不是每个矩阵都对称。很多甚至不是方阵。<bookmark mark='a'/>但每一个矩阵，无一例外，都能分成三个因子：一次正交坐标变换，沿坐标轴拉伸或投影，再一次正交变换。这些坐标变换可以是旋转，也可以是反射。我们的例子用的是两次旋转。<bookmark mark='b'/>这就是奇异值分解：A等于U乘Σ乘V转置。

fb14cea3f46e.en: Where do the turns and stretches come from? <bookmark mark='a'/> A transpose A is symmetric, and never negative: x transpose A transpose A x is a length squared. <bookmark mark='b'/> So the spectral theorem gives it perpendicular eigenvectors v, with eigenvalues sigma squared. <bookmark mark='c'/> Send each v through A and divide by sigma, for nonzero sigma. Complete the orthonormal bases for any zero singular values. <bookmark mark='d'/> These u's are perpendicular too, and of length one. <bookmark mark='e'/> So A sends perpendicular v's to perpendicular u's, stretched by the sigmas: the decomposition. <bookmark mark='f'/> Beltrami and Jordan found it in 1873 and 1874; Gene Golub and William Kahan's algorithm of 1965 is what computers still use.
fb14cea3f46e.zh: 这些旋转和拉伸是从哪里来的？<bookmark mark='a'/>A转置A是对称的，而且从不为负：x转置A转置A x是一个长度的平方。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以谱定理给了它一组互相垂直的特征向量v，特征值是σ的平方。<bookmark mark='c'/>对非零σ，把每个v送进A，再除以σ。若有零奇异值，就把两边补成完整的标准正交基。<bookmark mark='d'/>这些u也互相垂直，长度为1。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以A把互相垂直的v送到互相垂直的u，按σ拉伸：这就是分解。<bookmark mark='f'/>贝尔特拉米和若尔当在1873和1874年发现了它；吉恩·戈卢布和威廉·卡汉1965年的算法，计算机至今还在用。

e0333d054ddb.en: Why it works takes four lines. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take a symmetric matrix and a start with a nonzero component along its dominant eigenvector. Write the start in the orthonormal eigenvector basis. <bookmark mark='b'/> k multiplications stretch each part by its eigenvalue to the k. <bookmark mark='c'/> Pull out the largest: every other part is multiplied by a ratio below one, to the k. <bookmark mark='d'/> So the angle shrinks like lambda two over lambda one, to the k: a straight line on a log scale. <bookmark mark='e'/> The eigenvalue estimate does twice as well, because the Rayleigh quotient sits at a stationary point, where small errors in direction barely move it.
e0333d054ddb.zh: 为什么有效，四行就够了。<bookmark mark='a'/>取一个对称矩阵，起点沿主特征向量的分量必须非零。把起点写在标准正交的特征向量基下。<bookmark mark='b'/>乘k次，每一部分都被它的特征值的k次方拉伸。<bookmark mark='c'/>把最大的提出来：其他每一部分，都乘上一个小于1的比值的k次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以夹角按λ2比λ1的k次方缩小：在对数坐标上是一条直线。<bookmark mark='e'/>特征值的估计还要快一倍，因为瑞利商在驻点处，方向上的小误差几乎不改变它。

163508c305ea.en: We'll do it with the thirty novels. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take the ten thousand commonest words and count how often each pair turns up within four words: a hundred million cells, from 4.35 million words of text. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then turn counts into surprise, Part 1's way: the log of how many times more often two words meet than by chance, the pointwise mutual information. Keep its positive part. <bookmark mark='c'/> Monday and morning: 4.16. The and of meet 85,086 times, but they meet everything: 0.69. <bookmark mark='d'/> For the SVD table, we smooth the context distribution with the three-quarters power, then keep positive values.
163508c305ea.zh: 我们用那三十部小说来做。<bookmark mark='a'/>取最常见的一万个词，数每一对词在四个词以内同时出现多少次：一亿个格子，来自4.35百万词的文本。<bookmark mark='b'/>再按第1部分的办法，把计数变成意外度：两个词相遇的次数，是偶然相遇的多少倍，取对数，就是点互信息。只留下它的正的部分。<bookmark mark='c'/>monday和morning：4.16。the和of一起出现了85086次，可它们和什么词都相遇：0.69。<bookmark mark='d'/>做SVD用的表，还会先把上下文分布取四分之三次方并归一化，再只保留正值。

8f32e7afdcc2.en: In 2013 Tomas Mikolov and colleagues at Google learned word vectors with a guessing game. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each word gets two vectors, one as the word and one as a neighbour. <bookmark mark='b'/> Training raises a word's dot product with its real neighbours, through the logistic function, and lowers it with 5 random words. <bookmark mark='c'/> That is skip-gram with negative sampling, the heart of word2vec: cheap enough for billions of words in hours.
8f32e7afdcc2.zh: 2013年，谷歌的托马斯·米科洛夫和同事用一个猜谜游戏学习词向量。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个词有两个向量，一个在它作为中心词时用，一个在它作为邻居时用。<bookmark mark='b'/>训练会通过逻辑函数，提高一个词和它真实邻居的点积，并降低它和5个随机词的点积。<bookmark mark='c'/>这就是带负采样的跳字模型，word2vec的核心：便宜到几小时就能学完几十亿个词。

817584545d4d.en: Why do guessing and counting agree? In 2014 Omer Levy and Yoav Goldberg showed why. <bookmark mark='a'/> Collect the loss for one word and one context: the pair appears as a real neighbour some number of times, and as a negative about k times the word's count times the context's sampling probability. <bookmark mark='b'/> Treat their dot product x as free; set the derivative to zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> The ratio of the two logistic terms is e to the x. <bookmark mark='d'/> Take logs: this maximizes the log objective. If negatives follow the empirical context distribution, the best dot product is PMI minus log k. With smoothed negatives, as in our run, use their sampling probability in the same log-count ratio: a generalized shifted PMI.
817584545d4d.zh: 为什么猜测和计数会一致？2014年，奥默·列维和约阿夫·戈德堡说明了原因。<bookmark mark='a'/>把一个词和一个上下文的损失收集起来：这一对作为真实邻居出现若干次，作为负样本出现的次数，大约是k乘这个词的计数，再乘这个上下文的采样概率。<bookmark mark='b'/>把它们的点积x当作自由的；令导数为0。<bookmark mark='c'/>两个逻辑函数项之比是e的x次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>取对数：这使对数目标达到最大。如果负样本服从经验上下文分布，最好的点积就是点互信息减去log k。若像我们的训练一样，用平滑后的负采样分布，就把它的采样概率代入同一个对数计数比：这是广义的平移点互信息。

a4b8e70c7f76.en: Our intuition comes from three dimensions, and in 768 it misleads us. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two random directions: in two dimensions, any angle. <bookmark mark='b'/> In three, right angles are already the most common. <bookmark mark='c'/> In a hundred, the angle's standard deviation around ninety degrees is 5.8 degrees, <bookmark mark='d'/> and in 768, 2.1.
a4b8e70c7f76.zh: 我们的直觉来自三维，到了768维，它会误导我们。<bookmark mark='a'/>两个随机方向：在二维，什么角度都有。<bookmark mark='b'/>在三维，直角附近已经最常见。<bookmark mark='c'/>在一百维，夹角围绕90度的标准差是5.8度，<bookmark mark='d'/>在768维，标准差是2.1度。

3c81cf3aad6d.en: Now lengths. <bookmark mark='a'/> As d grows, a random vector's length piles up around root d. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its square is a sum of d squares, <bookmark mark='c'/> with mean d and variance 2 d. <bookmark mark='d'/> The square root changes by one over two root d per unit, so the length's spread is about one over root two for large d: the length grows, the spread approaches a constant. Measured at 768, 0.702.
3c81cf3aad6d.zh: 再看长度。<bookmark mark='a'/>d越大，一个随机向量的长度越集中在根号d附近。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的平方是d个平方之和，<bookmark mark='c'/>均值是d，方差是2d。<bookmark mark='d'/>平方根在d附近，每变化1只变化2倍根号d分之1，所以长度的散布在d很大时，大约是根号2分之1：长度不断增长，散布则趋近一个常数。在768维实测，0.702。

842d02761a24.en: The Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma, from 1984, in Dasgupta and Gupta's form of 2003. <bookmark mark='a'/> To keep every squared distance among n points within one plus or minus epsilon, a random projection to about log n over epsilon squared dimensions, up to a constant, suffices. <bookmark mark='b'/> For our thousand points at ten percent: 5,921. The starting dimension doesn't appear at all. Let's prove it.
842d02761a24.zh: 约翰逊–林登斯特劳斯引理，1984年，这里用的是达斯古普塔和古普塔2003年的形式。<bookmark mark='a'/>要让n个点之间的每个距离平方都保持在1加减ε倍以内，随机投影到与log n除以ε平方成比例的维数就够了。<bookmark mark='b'/>对我们的一千个点、10%的误差：5921维。起始的维数根本没有出现。我们来证明它。

abe8384c9779.en: The lemma promises every pair at once. <bookmark mark='a'/> The worst pair of all, five random matrices per k. <bookmark mark='b'/> The union bound's guarantee, from k of 200: at 768 it promises 0.30, and the worst pair measured 0.25. <bookmark mark='c'/> In the worst case no map can do much better: in 2017 Kasper Green Larsen and Jelani Nelson proved log n over epsilon squared optimal, up to a constant.
abe8384c9779.zh: 引理保证的是所有点对同时成立。<bookmark mark='a'/>所有点对里最差的那一对，每个k取五个随机矩阵。<bookmark mark='b'/>联合界给出的保证，从k等于200开始：在768维，它保证0.30，而最差的一对实测是0.25。<bookmark mark='c'/>而且在最坏的情况下，没有任何映射能好太多：2017年，卡斯珀·格林·拉森和杰拉尼·纳尔逊证明了，log n除以ε平方在常数倍以内是最优的。

27ba949737de.en: The escapees thin out slowly, like a power law: density falling as lambda to the minus alpha. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2019 Charles Martin and Michael Mahoney fitted such tails across hundreds of trained networks: exponents nearly always between 1.5 and 5, and within a family, heavier tails went with better test accuracy. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fitted to all 48 of GPT-2's matrices: 44 fall in that range; our layer has alpha 3.53. The independent Gaussian reference has a compact limiting bulk, rather than a power-law tail.
27ba949737de.zh: 跑出去的特征值慢慢变稀，像幂律一样：密度按λ的负α次方下降。<bookmark mark='a'/>2019年，查尔斯·马丁和迈克尔·马奥尼在几百个训练过的网络上拟合了这样的尾巴：指数几乎总在1.5到5之间，而在同一族模型里，尾巴越重，测试准确率越好。<bookmark mark='b'/>拟合GPT-2全部48个矩阵：有44个落在这个范围里；我们看的那一层，α是3.53。独立高斯参考矩阵的极限主体有紧支撑，而不是幂律尾部。

ccd5046628ea.en: A gradient is a matrix too, with its own singular values. <bookmark mark='a'/> A layer turns each token's vector x into W x. <bookmark mark='b'/> By the chain rule, Part 4's subject, the gradient for one weight sums, over tokens, the error at that output times the input. <bookmark mark='c'/> So the gradient is a sum of outer products, rank one per token. <bookmark mark='d'/> Its rank is at most the number of tokens. In practice it is often approximately low rank: errors and inputs concentrate in a few directions.
ccd5046628ea.zh: 梯度也是一个矩阵，有它自己的奇异值。<bookmark mark='a'/>一层把每个词元的向量x变成W x。<bookmark mark='b'/>根据链式法则，也就是第4部分的主题，一个权重的梯度，是对各个词元，把那个输出处的误差乘上输入，再加起来。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以梯度是一些外积之和，每个词元贡献一个秩1的块。<bookmark mark='d'/>它的秩至多是词元的个数。实际中，它往往是近似低秩的：误差和输入集中在几个共同的方向上。

4fdddd60dfe9.en: The spectral norm has become an optimizer. <bookmark mark='a'/> Which step of spectral size one changes the loss most along a gradient G? Write G with its SVD. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each diagonal entry is at most one, so the best is U V transpose: the gradient with every stretch set to one. <bookmark mark='c'/> That is Muon's normalized direction; take its negative for descent. It is computed with five Newton-Schulz iterations, matrix products that push singular values towards one. On a real gradient, 59 percent start below a hundredth of the largest. <bookmark mark='d'/> After five steps, 73 percent lie between 0.6 and 1.3. Part 11 builds the optimizer.
4fdddd60dfe9.zh: 谱范数变成了一个优化器。<bookmark mark='a'/>沿着梯度G，谱大小为1的哪一步让损失变化最大？用奇异值分解写出G。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个对角元至多是1，所以最好的一步是U乘V转置：把梯度的每个拉伸都设成1。<bookmark mark='c'/>这就是Muon的归一化方向；下降时取它的负方向。用五次牛顿–舒尔茨迭代算出来，这些矩阵乘法把奇异值推向1。在一个真实的梯度上，开始时有59%的奇异值不到最大值的百分之一。<bookmark mark='d'/>五步之后，73%落在0.6到1.3之间。第11部分会搭建这个优化器。
